title: chaetoseris macrantha
intro: Chaetoseris macrantha, commonly known as the Large-flowered Chaetoseris, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaetoseris macrantha include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through various studies.
